traits.phyllary_series.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Senecio (p. 430), which then held Jacobaea; these hold for Jacobaea as now drawn: involucral bracts about equal, in one series (or seeming two by overlap), often with small bracteoles below.

traits.receptacle.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Senecio (p. 430), which then held Jacobaea; these hold for Jacobaea as now drawn: receptacle flat or convex, naked.

traits.receptacle_shape.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Senecio (p. 430), which then held Jacobaea; these hold for Jacobaea as now drawn: receptacle flat or convex.

traits.pappus.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Senecio (p. 430), which then held Jacobaea; these hold for Jacobaea as now drawn: pappus of many usually white capillary bristles.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Abrams and Ferris vol. 4, genus Senecio (p. 430), which then held Jacobaea; these hold for Jacobaea as now drawn: leaves alternate (or all basal).
